mapper.select: SELECT * FROM proj_project_plan_version WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND status='DRAFT' AND deleted=b'0'
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(revision_no),0)+1 FROM proj_project_plan_version WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId}
mapper.update: UPDATE proj_project_plan_version SET designer_document=#{query.designer}, version=version+1, updater=#{query.updater},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND id=#{query.draftId} AND base_plan_version_id=#{query.basePlanVersionId} AND version=#{query.expectedVersion} AND status='DRAFT' AND deleted=b'0'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM proj_project_plan_version WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND status IN ('EFFECTIVE','SUPERSEDED') AND deleted=b'0' ORDER BY revision_no DESC

SELECT v.* FROM proj_project_plan_version v JOIN proj_project p ON p.active_plan_version_id=v.id AND p.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND p.id=v.project_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.id=#{query.projectId} AND p.deleted=b'0' AND v.status='EFFECTIVE' AND v.deleted=b'0'
mapper.update: UPDATE proj_project SET lifecycle_status='NORMAL_CLOSED', status='NORMAL_CLOSED', project_close_time=#{query.closedAt}, version=version+1, updater=#{query.updater}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id=#{query.projectId} AND active_plan_version_id=#{query.planVersionId} AND version=#{query.expectedProjectVersion} AND lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND deleted=b'0'
